snippet.title: Harbor Official Gameplay Reveal // VALORANT
snippet.description:
Here’s Harbor in action.

Hailing from the coast of India, this new Controller Agent commands a mix of tide and torrent to shield allies and pummel opponents. 

Lock him in with the launch of EPISODE 5: ACT III.

Video created in collaboration with AT03: 
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCeOectCkAtIegeFquTUT3HQ/videos
https://www.instagram.com/ig_at03/

Music Track:
“RAJA” by VALORANT, ARB4, Tienas, Mangal Suvarnan

Play VALORANT: https://riot.com/3idlntG
Join the Discord server: https://riot.com/3n1xltZ

Follow us:

Instagram: https://riot.com/2S8uTnmhnf
